 For the first time in KBL history, as many as 30 people wore professional uniforms.
 The 2026 KBL Rookie Draft was held at Jamsil Student Gymnasium on the 20th. And it became a festival where 30 out of 44 people received professional nominations.
 It is the first time in history that 30 people have been selected professionally in the KBL rookie draft, which began in 1998. And the nomination rate of 68.2% is the highest level since 2016 (68.4%).
 사진 확대 Lee Dong-geun of Korea University was the first main character in the list. He was chosen by KT. Photo = Courtesy of KBL The first overall protagonist was Lee Dong-geun. Already considered the biggest fish in the golden draft, he wore the Suwon KT uniform.
 Kim Seung-woo was chosen by Ulsan Hyundai Mobis as the second overall pick. And Ko Chan-yu, who competed for the top nomination with him, became the new face of Seoul SK.
 The last of the rotary pick was taken by Gu Min-gyo Bridge. He is expected to be a great help to Anyang's Jeonggwanjang Forward.
 "Asia MVP" Lee Ju-young received the fifth overall nomination by the Korea Gas Corporation in Daegu. And Chae-hyung Lee was chosen by Wonju DB and made me look forward to the future.
 Seoul Samsung chose Shim Joo-eon as the seventh overall nomination. And Changwon LG named Son Yoo-chan as the eighth overall, reinforcing the lead.
 Goyang Sono called the name of Woo Sung-hee, the best big man in the draft, as the ninth overall pick. Busan KCC, which finished the last round of the first round, chose Lee Hae-sol to strengthen its lead.
 사진 확대 Lee Dong-geun, Kim Seung-woo, Ko Chan-yu, and Gu Min-gyo. They are the protagonists of the golden draft that will dominate the KBL in the future. Photo = Courtesy of KBL There was no pass in the second round. KCC chose Lee Kwan-woo, SK chose Yoo Jung-won, LG chose Koo In-kyo, and Samsung chose Kim Seo-won.
 Won Gun, who was mentioned as a candidate for this draft still pick, was placed in the arms of DB as the fifth pick in the second round. Since then, Korea Gas Corporation has Song Jung-woo, Jeong Kwan-jang has Han Jae-hyuk, Sonoga Jang Ji-min, Hyundai Mobis has Kim Doo-jin, and KT has Kim Tae-hyung.
 In the third round, seven players were selected. KT named Kim Soo-oh, Hyundai Mobis named Lee Joo-min, SK named Lim Sung-chae, Jeonggwanjang Choi Jun-hwan, and Korea Gas Corporation named Lee Joo-seok.
 Samsung chose Lee Kun-hee and LG chose Hong Sang-min, while DB, Sono, and KCC did not exercise their nomination rights.
 In the fourth round, three players also wore professional uniforms. First, Sono nominated Yeo Chan-young, and then LG selected Baek Seung-hyuk and Samsung Lee Kyung-min.
 [MIN JUN KU, MK Sports Reporter]
